# Sea Island Builders (concept site by Kerblabs)

> Concept site for Sea Island Builders, a custom home builder on Sullivan's Island, South Carolina, serving the Charleston area. Facts are taken from seaislandbuilders.com. Not affiliated with the company.

## Facts
- Address: 2113 Middle Street, Sullivan's Island, South Carolina
- Phone: 843.883.7430
- Established: 2004
- Tagline: Experience Unrivaled

- Areas: Awendaw, Charleston, Folly Beach, Isle of Palms, James Island, Mt. Pleasant, Kiawah Island, Sullivan's Island, West Ashley
- Credentials (per their site): four licensed residential homebuilders, a licensed realtor, architect on staff, GuildQuality member and Guildmaster Award winner, Charleston Home Builders Association and Home Builders Association of SC member, LEED Green Associate, EPA Lead Certified
- Prices: not published
